observed_contract.important_coupling: TargetProfileProjection carries the complete WP1201 profile_sha256 even though observed_shape consumes only the eight listed source facts. TwinBootstrapPlan serializes source_profile_sha256, so unrelated WP1201 changes alter the plan identity.

result.direct_finding: For every single-field irrelevant perturbation tested (value change and OBSERVED->UNKNOWN), T1 semantics were unchanged while current plan identity changed solely because full profile provenance digest participates in the serialized plan.

interpretation.supported: Separate immutable provenance identity from semantic validity/revalidation identity.
interpretation.not_supported: Removing the full source profile digest from receipts or canonical provenance.
interpretation.minimal_delta: Keep source_profile_sha256. Add a projection_input_binding_sha256 derived mechanically from _T1_FACT_BINDINGS and the corresponding canonical fact records; use this scoped digest for T1 semantic cache/revalidation decisions, while plan/full profile hashes remain receipt/provenance identities.
interpretation.dependency_safety: The binding source set must be derived from _T1_FACT_BINDINGS rather than duplicated by hand, and tests must fail if a bound source fact is omitted.

counterhypotheses: Any change to the full source profile may intentionally require a new immutable plan receipt even when T1 semantics are unchanged. This is compatible with the proposed split because receipt identity stays full-profile-bound.
The eight current T1 source facts may be semantically incomplete for real userspace fidelity. The scoped binding must not be treated as evidence that the current projection is sufficient.
A downstream consumer may currently use plan sha as both receipt and validity key. The implementation must split those roles explicitly rather than silently changing existing receipt semantics.

negative_space.boot_scope: Still absent from WP1201 G1; this E4 does not solve boot-epoch identity.
negative_space.runtime_topology: pipewire_topology is not consumed by current T1 projection even though runtime checks later inspect multimedia state; that gap should be handled as runtime witness/fidelity evidence rather than silently added to stable T1 input without measurement.
